meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装好后,涉及 git 时,Claude 自动把多文件改动拆成多个小提交,沿用仓库风格写说明;还能 rebase/squash 整理历史,查找代码是谁、何时加的。
howto.when: 当请求涉及任何 git 操作,或出现 'commit'、'rebase'、'who wrote' 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动拆成几个逻辑清晰的提交。
say.note: 会按文件/模块拆分并生成多个提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
查一下这行代码是谁、什么时候加的。
say.note: 会用 git blame/bisect 等定位来源。

howto.what_en: After installation, for any git operation, Claude automatically analyzes changes and history, splits multi-file changes into atomic commits, follows the repository's commit style, and can rewrite history (rebase/squash) or trace who/when introduced a code line.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git operation, or when the user says keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'who wrote', etc.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several logical commits.
say_en.note: It will split by file/module and create multiple commits.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: It will run rebase/squash to merge them.

say_en.text: Find who and when added this line.
say_en.note: Uses git blame/bisect to trace the origin.
